purpose: A versioned Luxshare business profile for future semantic analysis and deterministic news classification. This V1 file is not connected to production logic.

luxshare_company_profile.title: Company Profile
luxshare_company_profile.excerpt: Luxshare describes enterprise communication products including high-speed interconnect, optical modules and heat-dissipation modules; consumer products including TWS, smart wear, wireless charging and smart speakers; and automotive wiring harnesses, connectors, intelligent cabins and central gateways.

luxshare_2022_annual_report.title: Luxshare Precision Industry Co., Ltd. Annual Report 2022
luxshare_2022_annual_report.excerpt: The report states that the computing-center business extended from components and modules to complete server assembly and lists ACC/DAC, AOC, transceivers, cable modules, water-cooled plates, fans, heat sinks, UPS and communication power products.

luxshare_data_center_solutions.title: Data Center Solutions
luxshare_data_center_solutions.excerpt: The site presents cabinet, server and switch solution packages covering electrical and optical connection, high-speed cables and connectors, thermal management, power management and CPO.

luxshare_electrical_connection.title: Electrical Connection
luxshare_electrical_connection.excerpt: The page lists DAC, ACC and AEC copper-cable solutions across SFP, QSFP and OSFP form factors with bandwidths up to 1.6T.

luxshare_cpo.title: CPO
luxshare_cpo.excerpt: The page presents a 3.2T co-packaged-optics module solution using silicon-photonics co-packaging technology.

luxshare_thermal_management.title: Thermal Management
luxshare_thermal_management.excerpt: The page presents water-cooling plates and an overall CDU solution, including a 60 kW 2U heat-exchange scheme.

luxshare_power_management.title: Power Management
luxshare_power_management.excerpt: The page presents a universal redundant server power supply for mainstream server power architectures.

luxshare_ai_data_center_event.title: Luxshare-Tech showcases its AI Data Center Solution at Electronica China 2024
luxshare_ai_data_center_event.excerpt: Luxshare-Tech presented stacked CDU cabinets and immersion-cooling tanks and described product lines serving servers, switches, whole cabinets and AI computing clusters.

luxshare_apple_airpods_history.title: Tim Cook visits the AirPods plant
luxshare_apple_airpods_history.excerpt: The article describes Apple as a Luxshare client and discusses the complexity of AirPods production at the visited plant.
